items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把细胞微环境预训练与生成式组织模拟结合，用于提出治疗扰动策略；治疗设计结果属于计算生成的候选方案，不能替代疗效实验。
items.abstract_zh: 计算设计已经改变了许多工程领域，在这些领域中，模拟器可在实验开发和测试前探索数百万个候选设计配置。生物医学中的治疗设计一直难以采用计算设计方法，因为疾病进展和治疗反应源于人类组织内多种细胞类型之间的相互作用，而支配这些相互作用的生化参数在很大程度上未知，并且可能无法获知。在此，我们介绍 Cell Interaction Foundation Model（CIFM），一种虚拟组织模型，它以空间转录组种子为基础，在任意治疗条件下前向模拟人类组织中细胞的转录动态。CIFM 是一个几何图神经网络，在跨越人类组织类型和疾病状态的数百万个细胞微环境上通过自监督遮蔽转录组预测训练；随后，生成式、自回归、Monte Carlo 推演从空间转录组种子出发，在组合扰动下模拟转录动态。我们通过展示 CIFM 在基因表达预测和插补、疾病分类、再现前列腺癌模型中的扰动反应以及恢复细胞—细胞测序实验所测量的 T 细胞—肿瘤信号中的准确性增益来验证它。除这些常规任务外，CIFM 还通过生成式组织模拟推演实现靶标识别和治疗设计。分析逾 10^6 个单一和组合扰动后，CIFM 为癌症和自身免疫疾病设计免疫治疗策略；这些策略利用信号通路的组合操纵诱导或抑制免疫激活。总体而言，CIFM 显示了生成式人工智能方法如何用于建模高度相互作用生物系统中的涌现行为，为深入理解组织行为和大规模治疗设计带来新方法。
items.author_line: Lu, Y., Zhang, W., Chen, Y.-J., Yin, J., Chen, L., Fleisher, K., Gornet, J., Liu, R., Wang, Z. J., Poon, Y., You, Y., Thomson, M.

items.title: DBToken: A Database Tokenizer for Medical Event Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: Objectives: Transformer models for electronic health records require converting clinical data into token sequences, however standardized tokenization and evaluation frameworks are lacking. We introduce DBToken, an open-source library, and bits-per-row (BPR), a metric for comparing tokenization strategies. Materials and Methods DBToken accepts Medical Event Data Standard (MEDS)-compatible input and supports multiple text, numeric, and temporal tokenization strategies. BPR extends the bits-per-byte metric used in language models to enable comparison across tokenization strategies. Results DBToken efficiently tokenized data across configurations. BPR identified the vocabulary size associated with the best clinical outcome performance and localized differences in numeric tokenization performance by token class. Discussion Optimal tokenization strategies for medical foundation models are a subject of active research. DBToken enables reproducible tokenization experiments, while BPR efficiently screens vocabulary sizes and numeric representations before downstream evaluation. Conclusion DBToken and the BPR metric provide open-source infrastructure for reproducible EHR tokenization and cross-strategy evaluation.
items.summary_zh: DBToken 为 MEDS 兼容电子健康记录提供开源 tokenization 库，并提出 bits-per-row（BPR）来比较文本、数值和时间 tokenization 策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: EHR 基础模型的 tokenization 会影响下游比较的可解释性与可复现性；该工作提供统一实验基础设施和筛选指标，但不报告临床部署或患者获益。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：用于电子健康记录的 Transformer 模型需要将临床数据转换为 token 序列，但标准化的 tokenization 和评估框架尚缺。我们介绍开源库 DBToken，以及用于比较 tokenization 策略的指标 bits-per-row（BPR）。材料与方法：DBToken 接受兼容 Medical Event Data Standard（MEDS）的输入，并支持多种文本、数值和时间 tokenization 策略。BPR 扩展了语言模型中使用的 bits-per-byte 指标，从而能够跨 tokenization 策略进行比较。结果：DBToken 能够在不同配置下高效地将数据 token 化。BPR 识别出与最佳临床结局表现相关的词汇表大小，并按 token 类别定位数值 tokenization 性能的差异。讨论：医疗基础模型的最优 tokenization 策略是活跃研究主题。DBToken 能够实现可复现的 tokenization 实验，而 BPR 可在下游评估前高效筛选词汇表大小和数值表示。结论：DBToken 和 BPR 指标为可复现的 EHR tokenization 及跨策略评估提供开源基础设施。
items.author_line: Shin I, McCann K, Marino G, Siam UT, Li H, Stutz E, Edara R, Loza AJ

items.title: General-purpose time-series foundation models enable sample-efficient transfer learning in retinal electrophysiology
items.abstract_or_text: Electroretinography (ERG) measures the functional response of distinct retinal cells to light, but was largely displaced by structural imaging in the 2000s. Standardization efforts by the International Society for Clinical Electrophysiology of Vision (ISCEV) began in the late 1980s, and collapsed the rich time-series traces into reproducible components and implicit times. Recent improvements in hardware (RETeval) and software (artificial intelligence) may increase the utility of ERG data. However, no ERG-specific foundation models exist, and there are not enough public datasets to train one. We asked whether time-series foundation models (FMs) trained without ERG-specific pre-training could be adapted through transfer learning. Using two public datasets, PERG-IOBA (pattern ERG with ocular diagnoses), and LEOPs (full-field ERG focusing on Autism Spectrum Disorder, ASD), we interrogated how FMs could improve over smaller within-domain models. We measured the binary (healthy/typically developing vs any annotation) and multiclass (specific family/diagnosis) classification performance of both frozen and fine-tuned FMs, alongside custom autoencoder and multiscale models, using patient-aware splits for cross validation. We benchmark the same architectures against PTB-XL, a large 12-lead ECG corpus, as both a control for each approach and to explore scaling behavior. We show that 1) pre-trained FMs can reconstruct masked traces from all three datasets, 2) frozen and fine-tuned embeddings, especially combined with multimodal metadata through masked autoencoders, performed best on classification tasks. Performance on PTB-XL was maintained down to 300 records, comparable in size to the ERG datasets. We could not reproduce published classification performance on the ASD task. Taken together, these results support general purpose foundation models as a practical approach to ERG analysis.
items.summary_zh: 使用 PERG-IOBA、LEOPs 和 PTB-XL 数据，评估通用时间序列基础模型向 retinal electrophysiology 迁移的能力；研究采用患者感知交叉验证，并未复现已发表的 ASD 分类表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它在小型 ERG 数据场景中检验通用预训练的样本效率，并将未复现结果明确报告；证据支持分析方法研究，尚不证明诊断用途。
items.abstract_zh: 视网膜电图（ERG）测量不同视网膜细胞对光的功能反应，但在 2000 年代大多被结构成像取代。国际视觉电生理学会（ISCEV）在 20 世纪 80 年代末开始的标准化工作，将丰富的时间序列轨迹压缩为可复现的组分和隐含时间。硬件（RETeval）和软件（人工智能）的近期改进可能提高 ERG 数据的效用。然而，目前不存在 ERG 专用基础模型，公开数据集也不足以训练一个。我们询问：未经 ERG 特异预训练的时间序列基础模型（FMs）能否通过迁移学习适配。我们使用两个公开数据集：PERG-IOBA（包含眼科诊断的图形 ERG）和 LEOPs（聚焦 Autism Spectrum Disorder，ASD 的全视野 ERG），考察 FMs 如何优于较小的领域内模型。我们使用患者感知的数据划分进行交叉验证，测量冻结和微调 FMs 的二分类（健康/典型发育对任意注释）及多分类（特定家族/诊断）表现，同时比较定制自编码器和多尺度模型。我们还在大型 12 导联 ECG 语料 PTB-XL 上对同一架构进行基准测试，以作为每种方法的对照并探索扩展行为。我们显示：1）预训练 FMs 能够从全部三个数据集中重建被遮蔽的轨迹；2）冻结和微调后的嵌入，特别是通过遮蔽自编码器与多模态元数据结合时，在分类任务中表现最佳。在 PTB-XL 上，性能在数据量降至 300 条记录时仍得以保持，这与 ERG 数据集的规模相当。我们无法复现已发表的 ASD 任务分类表现。综合来看，这些结果支持通用基础模型作为 ERG 分析的一种实用途径。
items.author_line: Porter, H. L., Giles, C. B., Kottapalli, S., Wren, J. D.

items.title: FormalTCS: Benchmarking End-to-End Frontier Formal Theoretical Computer Science Research of Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) have shown growing potential for automated theoretical computer science (TCS) research, yet existing benchmarks remain far from realistic research settings. We introduce \ourbenchmark, an expert-validated benchmark for evaluating LLMs on frontier, end-to-end TCS research. \ourbenchmark contains 175 instances drawn from papers accepted to STOC, FOCS, SODA, and COLT in 2025-2026, preserving paper-specific definitions, assumptions, and proof dependencies, with expert-verified Lean formalizations and proofs. Evaluations of leading LLMs reveal that current models remain far from reliably completing the full research pipeline. In particular, autoformalization is the sharpest bottleneck: the best model achieves only 11.5 on translating natural-language claims into formal theorem statements, compared with 28.6 Pass@8 when proving human-provided formal statements. Building on \ourbenchmark, we further develop an automated TCS research framework that generates, formalizes, filters, and proves new claims. Of 64 generated claims, only 6 ultimately pass expert evaluation and proof verification, indicating that beyond formalization, limited research taste remains another major barrier to autonomous TCS research.
items.summary_zh: FormalTCS 以近期顶会论文中的定义、假设和 Lean 证明为基础，评测模型完成端到端理论计算机科学研究的能力，并报告自动形式化仍是主要短板。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 基准同时保留原始证明依赖并由专家核验 Lean 形式化，可将自然语言定理陈述、形式化和证明等环节区分评估，避免把局部成功解释为完整研究能力。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在自动化理论计算机科学（TCS）研究方面已显示出日益增长的潜力，但现有基准仍与真实研究场景相距甚远。我们提出 \ourbenchmark，这是一个经专家验证的基准，用于评估 LLM 在前沿、端到端 TCS 研究上的表现。\ourbenchmark 包含 175 个实例，取自 2025—2026 年被 STOC、FOCS、SODA 和 COLT 接收的论文，保留了论文特有的定义、假设和证明依赖关系，并配有经专家核验的 Lean 形式化与证明。对领先 LLM 的评估表明，当前模型距离可靠完成完整研究流程仍很远。尤其是，自动形式化是最突出的瓶颈：最佳模型将自然语言断言转写为形式化定理陈述时仅达到 11.5，而在证明人工提供的形式化陈述时的 Pass@8 为 28.6。在 \ourbenchmark 的基础上，我们进一步开发了一个自动化 TCS 研究框架，用于生成、形式化、筛选并证明新断言。在生成的 64 个断言中，最终仅有 6 个通过专家评估和证明验证，这表明除形式化之外，有限的研究判断力也是自主 TCS 研究的另一项主要障碍。
items.author_line: Dingzirui Wang, Xuanliang Zhang, Keyan Xu, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che

items.title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly paired with verifiers (step checkers, self-consistency filters, tool-based fact checkers, formal proof assistants) that claim to detect the model's errors. Yet the verification literature uses the word "level" to mean at least five different things: verification granularity, concept abstraction, risk tier, system-stack layer, and the epistemic source of the ground truth. We propose Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL), a meta-standard that classifies any verification scheme along a single axis: where does the verification spec come from, and what does the verdict guarantee? VAL ranges from L0 (LLM self-declaration; no deterministic anchor) through L2 (objective ground truth; correctness only) to L3/L4 (decidable systems with single-property or domain-level completeness), with L5 impossible in the unrestricted case. Central to VAL is the completeness blind spot: substitution- and sampling-based verifiers can confirm that proposed candidates hold, but cannot prove that no candidate was missed. We further identify a dichotomy the literature has not stated: completeness is reachable only for formally specifiable properties, whereas empirical open-world verification (fact-checking, diagnosis) caps at anchored correctness (L2). We document this gap empirically across four domains (symbolic mathematics, behavior monitoring, medical diagnosis, and code generation, the last a reverse validation with predictions stated before evidence) and in the strongest formal-verification baseline in our survey, whose authors note the verifier focuses on the correctness of each step. We show the levels of granularity, concept hierarchy, risk, and system stack are orthogonal to VAL, resolving a systematic conflation across 17 surveyed papers. Code and full assessment are released as supplementary material.
items.summary_zh: 该工作提出 Verification Autonomy Levels（VAL），按验证规范的来源及判定可保证的内容，区分 LLM 自述、客观真值和可判定形式系统中的验证能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它明确区分“候选答案正确”与“没有遗漏答案”的不同保证范围，并指出开放世界事实核查无法获得形式系统式的完备性；这有助于审慎解读 LLM 推理验证结果。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）日益与验证器结合使用，包括步骤检查器、自一致性筛选器、基于工具的事实检查器和形式化证明助手；这些验证器声称能够发现模型错误。然而，验证文献中“level”一词至少被用于五种不同含义：验证粒度、概念抽象、风险等级、系统栈层级，以及真值的认识论来源。我们提出 Verification Autonomy Levels（VAL），这是一个元标准，沿单一轴线分类任意验证方案：验证规范来自何处，以及判定结果保证什么。VAL 从 L0（LLM 自我声明；没有确定性依据），经由 L2（客观真值；仅保证正确性），到 L3/L4（对单一性质或领域层面具有完备性的可判定系统）；在不受限情形下，L5 不可能实现。VAL 的核心是完备性盲点：基于替换和采样的验证器可以确认所给候选项成立，却不能证明没有遗漏候选项。我们进一步指出一个文献尚未明确提出的二分：只有对可形式化规定的性质才能获得完备性，而经验性开放世界验证（事实核查、诊断）最高只能达到有依据的正确性（L2）。我们在四个领域中对这一差距进行了实证记录：符号数学、行为监测、医学诊断和代码生成；其中代码生成采用逆向验证，预测先于证据陈述。我们也考察了综述中最强的形式验证基线，其作者指出该验证器聚焦于每一步的正确性。我们表明，粒度、概念层级、风险和系统栈这些层面与 VAL 相互独立，从而澄清了 17 篇被调查论文中的系统性混淆。代码和完整评估作为补充材料发布。
items.author_line: Yajie Yin

items.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: As large language models evolve into decision-making agents, the ability to reason over preferences becomes fundamental to alignment, coordination, and collective intelligence. Yet, unlike standard benchmarks, real-world preference reasoning is inherently indeterminate: information may be incomplete, and valid solutions may not exist. We argue that indeterminacy, rather than correctness alone, is a central challenge for AI reasoning. We formalize this challenge along two axes, (i) epistemic indeterminacy, arising from incomplete, partial, or expressive preferences, and (ii) structural indeterminacy, arising from the non-existence of solutions under standard social choice concepts. Across a hierarchy of tasks, we show that state-of-the-art language models systematically fail to distinguish between determined and undetermined instances, exhibiting miscalibrated reasoning even in verification settings.
items.summary_zh: 该研究将偏好推理中的不定性区分为认识论不定性和结构性不定性，并测试语言模型能否识别问题是否存在确定解。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将“无解或信息不足”的识别纳入推理评测；结果表明，即使在验证设定中，先进模型也会系统性混淆可判定与不可判定实例。
items.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型演变为决策智能体，对偏好的推理能力成为对齐、协调和集体智能的基础。然而，与标准基准不同，现实世界的偏好推理本质上具有不定性：信息可能不完整，且有效解可能不存在。我们认为，相较于仅仅关注正确性，不定性是 AI 推理的核心挑战。我们沿两个轴对这一挑战进行形式化：（i）认识论不定性，源于不完整、部分或表达能力受限的偏好；（ii）结构性不定性，源于标准社会选择概念下解的不存在。在一系列层级化任务中，我们表明，最先进的语言模型系统性地无法区分可判定与不可判定实例，即使在验证设定中也表现出校准不当的推理。
items.author_line: Hadi Hosseini, Samarth Khanna, Xiyuan Wang

items.title: Rule-Compliant Visual Spatial Planning for Multimodal Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) combine linguistic reasoning with visual perception, yet their ability to perform visual spatial planning under explicit or previously unseen rule constraints remains underexplored. This setting requires models to jointly understand spatial layouts, interpret natural-language rules, and plan valid actions accordingly. To address this gap, we introduce RuleMaze, a controllable benchmark in which MLLMs must navigate mazes while obeying natural-language rules of varying complexity. RuleMaze isolates rule-compliant spatial planning by requiring accurate perception, rule interpretation, and constrained action planning. To enable scalable and systematic rule construction, we propose Language-Logic-Function Hybridization, which automatically generates natural-language rules and translates them into logical representations and executable validators, eliminating manual rule engineering. To improve rule following and generalization, we introduce Disentangled Multimodal Planning (DMP), which separates perception, execution, and rule verification through interpretable reasoning primitives. By disentangling these components, DMP facilitates systematic generalization to more complex and previously unseen rules, while providing transparent intermediate planning traces. Experiments demonstrate that DMP substantially improves rule compliance and planning success compared to end-to-end textual planning baselines. Overall, RuleMaze establishes a principled benchmark for studying grounded and interpretable rule-based spatial planning in MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/RuleMaze.
items.summary_zh: RuleMaze 用带自然语言规则的迷宫测量多模态模型的视觉空间规划，并以可执行验证器检查规则遵从和规划结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务将视觉感知、规则理解和受约束行动规划明确拆开，且新规则可系统生成；论文报告 DMP 相对端到端文本规划基线提升了规则遵从与规划成功率。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）结合了语言推理与视觉感知，但其在显式或此前未见规则约束下进行视觉空间规划的能力仍缺乏研究。这一设定要求模型同时理解空间布局、解释自然语言规则，并据此规划有效行动。为填补这一空白，我们提出 RuleMaze，这是一个可控基准：MLLM 必须在遵守不同复杂度自然语言规则的同时穿越迷宫。RuleMaze 通过要求准确感知、规则解释和受约束行动规划，分离出遵从规则的空间规划能力。为实现可扩展且系统的规则构建，我们提出 Language-Logic-Function Hybridization，它自动生成自然语言规则，并将其转换为逻辑表示和可执行验证器，无需人工规则工程。为改善规则遵从和泛化能力，我们提出 Disentangled Multimodal Planning（DMP），它通过可解释的推理原语将感知、执行和规则验证分开。通过拆分这些组成部分，DMP 能够系统地泛化到更复杂和此前未见的规则，同时提供透明的中间规划轨迹。实验表明，与端到端文本规划基线相比，DMP 大幅提升了规则遵从性和规划成功率。总体而言，RuleMaze 为研究 MLLM 中有依据且可解释的基于规则空间规划建立了一个有原则的基准。代码发布于 https://github.com/oceanflowlab/RuleMaze。
items.author_line: Yu Chen, Ting Lei, Yaoyi Li, Jia Cai, Zhecen Wu, Yang Liu

items.title: OmniHandwritingOCR: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs in Handwritten OCR Scenarios
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as OCR systems in document and knowledge-processing pipelines, but their ability to faithfully read real handwriting remains underexplored. Existing OCR benchmarks focus largely on printed text or clean single-line inputs, leaving limited coverage of realistic handwritten OCR scenarios such as multilingual handwriting, writer errors, and structurally complex mathematical expressions. We introduce OmniHandwritingOCR, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating MLLMs and OCR systems on handwritten OCR. It covers handwritten text recognition and handwritten mathematical expression recognition across six subtasks and twelve subsets, totaling 77.57K labeled images from public datasets and newly collected student writings. A key component is a difficulty-stratified multi-line formula corpus designed to test robustness under increasing structural complexity. We evaluate thirteen open- and closed-source systems with five complementary metrics under a unified protocol. Results show that current systems remain far from faithful transcription: performance drops sharply on complex multi-line formulas, model rankings vary across language and formula settings, and several generative models hallucinate plausible but visually unsupported corrections. OmniHandwritingOCR provides a challenging testbed for diagnosing language, content, structural, and visual-grounding failure modes of multimodal models in handwritten OCR scenarios.
items.summary_zh: OmniHandwritingOCR 覆盖手写文本与数学表达式识别，以六个子任务、十二个子集和统一指标诊断多模态模型在复杂手写内容上的失真与幻觉。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其中的难度分级多行公式语料可检验结构复杂度对识别的影响；13 个开放和闭源系统的统一评测显示，复杂公式和视觉依据不足的“纠正”仍是明显问题。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）日益被用于文档和知识处理流程中的 OCR 系统，但其忠实读取真实手写内容的能力仍研究不足。现有 OCR 基准主要关注印刷文本或干净的单行输入，对多语种手写、书写者错误和结构复杂的数学表达式等真实手写 OCR 场景覆盖有限。我们提出 OmniHandwritingOCR，这是一个用于评估 MLLM 和 OCR 系统手写 OCR 能力的诊断性基准。它覆盖手写文本识别和手写数学表达式识别，包含六个子任务和十二个子集，共计 77.57K 张带标注图像，数据来自公共数据集和新收集的学生书写材料。其中一个关键组成部分是按难度分级的多行公式语料库，旨在测试系统在结构复杂度逐步增加时的稳健性。我们以统一协议和五种互补指标评估了 13 个开放源与闭源系统。结果显示，当前系统距离忠实转写仍相差甚远：在复杂多行公式上性能急剧下降，模型排名会随语言和公式设定而变化，且若干生成式模型会产生看似合理但没有视觉依据的修正。OmniHandwritingOCR 为诊断多模态模型在手写 OCR 场景中的语言、内容、结构和视觉依据失效模式提供了一个有挑战性的测试平台。
items.author_line: Zinuo Guo, Min Zhang, Bo Jiang

items.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement-learning training of reasoning LLMs (e.g., GRPO) is expensive and requires a controllable environment, committing every contribution to a full training pipeline. We present EvoResearcher, a training-free, inference-time protocol that adds cost-bounded self-reflection to a single frozen LLM backbone. The protocol iterates generate -> self-critique -> revise until a maximum depth D is reached or the critique returns the CONFIRMED sentinel, an implicit early stop that lets the backbone self-verify its answer under a strict compute budget. Four self-reflective meta-reward components (correctness, efficiency, reflection depth, tool-call diversity) act as design principles instantiated as prompt-level mechanisms, so their benefits accrue with zero gradient updates. We validate the protocol on Big-Bench Hard (100 questions) and establish cross-domain behavior on GSM8K (500) and MATH (500) on the same frozen backbone, with cross-model replication on Qwen2.5-72B. All experiments use pure-reasoning benchmarks; the tool-call diversity component is validated in prompt-level form, and the environment-level and multi-agent extensions are design blueprints left to future work. On clean BBH the protocol does not raise accuracy beyond the 95% Wilson interval; its value is cost-bounded self-verification, with the CONFIRMED early stop terminating 82-88% of items at equal accuracy (about 2.1 generations per question).
items.summary_zh: EvoResearcher 在冻结 LLM 上迭代生成、自我批评与修订，并通过 CONFIRMED 提前停止控制推理成本；其报告的主要收益是保持准确率下减少生成次数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文清楚报告了 BBH、GSM8K、MATH 的样本规模和置信区间结论：BBH 准确率未显著提高，因此其结果更适合解读为受预算约束的自检方案，而非性能跃升。
items.abstract_zh: 对推理 LLM 进行强化学习训练（例如 GRPO）成本高昂，并且需要可控环境，使得每项贡献都必须接入完整训练流程。我们提出 EvoResearcher，这是一种免训练、推理时协议，在单个冻结 LLM 主干上加入受成本约束的自我反思。该协议反复执行“生成→自我批评→修订”，直至达到最大深度 D，或批评返回 CONFIRMED 哨兵值；后一种隐式提前停止使主干模型能够在严格计算预算下自行验证其答案。四个自反性元奖励组成部分，即正确性、效率、反思深度和工具调用多样性，作为在提示词层面实现的设计原则，因此其收益不需要任何梯度更新。我们在 Big-Bench Hard（100 个问题）上验证该协议，并在同一冻结主干上以 GSM8K（500 个问题）和 MATH（500 个问题）建立跨领域表现，同时在 Qwen2.5-72B 上进行跨模型复现。所有实验均使用纯推理基准；工具调用多样性组成部分在提示词层面得到验证，环境层面和多智能体扩展则是留待未来工作的设计蓝图。在干净的 BBH 上，该协议并未使准确率超出 95% Wilson 置信区间；它的价值在于受成本约束的自我验证，CONFIRMED 提前停止在准确率相同的情况下终止了 82%—88% 的项目，约为每个问题生成 2.1 次。
items.author_line: Wei Yu, Suxing Liu, Minjie Yu, Jiahao Wang, Zhijian Zheng, Haocheng Deng, Bing Li

items.title: Can a Lightweight Multimodal Model Estimate LLM Reasoning Performance? A Study for Compute-Optimal Document Inference
items.abstract_or_text: Uniformly allocating inference reasoning budgets to LLMs is expensive and prone to over-thinking penalties; especially in document tasks where visual layouts drive complexity. To address this, we introduce BudgetDoc, the first multimodal benchmark providing explicit supervision for model-budget-performance trade-offs across three document tasks. Using BudgetDoc, we train DRB (Document-Reasoning Balancer), an approx. 1B-parameter pre-flight estimator (SigLIP-2 + Qwen3-0.6B) that predicts ordinal model performance across budget levels, achieving a 0.753 weighted F1. When dynamically allocating reasoning budgets across five frontier models and three datasets, DRB matches or improves F1 scores compared to always-maximum-budget baselines in 9 of 15 configurations while drastically reducing cost. Finally, preliminary evaluations demonstrate DRB's potential to generalize to cross-model selection.
items.summary_zh: BudgetDoc 为文档任务提供模型、推理预算和性能之间的显式监督，并训练约 10 亿参数的 DRB 预测不同预算下的模型表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: DRB 在跨五个前沿模型、三个数据集的 15 种配置中，有 9 种达到或超过始终使用最大预算的 F1；这一结果可检验，但跨模型选择的泛化仅为初步证据。
items.abstract_zh: 为 LLM 均匀分配推理预算成本高昂，且容易产生过度思考惩罚；在视觉版式决定复杂度的文档任务中尤其如此。为此，我们提出 BudgetDoc，这是首个多模态基准，为三个文档任务中的模型—预算—性能权衡提供显式监督。利用 BudgetDoc，我们训练了 DRB（Document-Reasoning Balancer），这是一个约 10 亿参数的预先估计器（SigLIP-2 + Qwen3-0.6B），它预测不同预算水平下模型表现的序数等级，取得了 0.753 的加权 F1。DRB 在五个前沿模型和三个数据集之间动态分配推理预算时，在 15 种配置中的 9 种达到或提升了相对于始终采用最大预算基线的 F1，同时显著降低成本。最后，初步评估显示 DRB 具有泛化到跨模型选择的潜力。
items.author_line: Zishan Ahmad, Vishal Vaddina

items.title: Uncovering the Limits of Proof Sharing for Neural Networks
items.abstract_or_text: Robustness verification of neural networks is increasingly important, due to their use in many critical domains. In certain scenarios, proof sharing has been shown to accelerate incomplete verification techniques by reusing intermediate-layer abstract states, or templates, across queries. However, questions remain as to the robustness of template-based acceleration across varying network architectures, properties, datasets, and training methods. In this work, we perform a systematic study of the effectiveness of template-based acceleration and its limits. Our study shows that template subsumption rates can vary widely across scenarios. We present a novel metric of jointly stable neurons to explain this variation, showing that in some cases template-based techniques are very unlikely to provide any speedup. Then, we present FastCert, a novel technique for automatically distributing templates across neural network layers to increase performance impact, eschewing templates entirely if they are unlikely to produce a speedup. Across a large set of covering-design based L_0-verification tasks, FastCert achieved an average speedup of 1.13x over an extant template-based reuse technique.
items.summary_zh: 该研究系统考察神经网络鲁棒性验证中的证明共享何时有效，并提出依据联合稳定神经元指标决定模板在层间分配或放弃复用的 FastCert。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它不只报告加速结果，也说明模板复用会因架构、性质、数据集和训练方式而失效；在大规模 L_0 验证任务上，平均加速为 1.13 倍，幅度有限且可量化。
items.abstract_zh: 鉴于神经网络被用于许多关键领域，其鲁棒性验证日益重要。在某些场景中，证明共享已被证明可通过跨查询复用中间层抽象状态或模板，加速不完全验证技术。然而，基于模板的加速在不同网络架构、性质、数据集和训练方法下的稳健性仍有待研究。在这项工作中，我们系统研究了基于模板加速的有效性及其局限。研究显示，模板包含率可在不同场景间大幅变化。我们提出联合稳定神经元这一新指标来解释该变化，并表明在某些情形中，基于模板的技术很不可能带来任何加速。随后，我们提出 FastCert，这是一种新技术，可自动将模板分配到神经网络各层以提升性能影响；若模板不太可能带来加速，则完全不使用模板。在一大组基于覆盖设计的 L_0 验证任务上，FastCert 相比现有的基于模板复用技术实现了平均 1.13 倍加速。
items.author_line: Kanak Das, Shubham Ugare, Bor-Yuh Evan Chang, Sasa Misailovic, Gagandeep Singh, Manu Sridharan

items.title: Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machines: Interpretable Quantum Machine Learning with Commuting Projector Clauses
items.abstract_or_text: Tsetlin Machines (TMs) learn interpretable Boolean clauses using finite-state automata. We introduce the Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine (QL-TM), which replaces Boolean literals with quantum propositions represented by projectors while retaining classical include/exclude automata. Clauses are restricted to commuting measurement contexts and activate through the Born probability of their joint projector. We prove an exact reduction to ordinary Boolean TM clauses in diagonal computational-basis contexts and connect Pauli-projector clauses to stabilizer and syndrome semantics. Controlled experiments on Bell states, phase-flip syndromes, randomized 16-class stabilizer tasks, mixed literal pools, context-budget ablations, and finite-shot noise show that correct non-diagonal contexts recover physically meaningful clauses, while diagonal or wrong contexts lose the relevant phase/syndrome information. The context-budget results closely follow the predicted separability ladder 2^(b-k) as true stabilizer generators are removed. The contribution is a controlled bridge between Tsetlin clause learning and quantum logic, not a claim of quantum advantage.
items.summary_zh: Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine（QL-TM）以量子投影算符表示命题，在可交换测量语境内学习可解释子句，并证明其在对角计算基语境中精确退化为普通 Boolean Tsetlin Machine 子句。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文给出明确的归约证明，并用 Bell 态、稳定子任务、语境预算消融和有限采样噪声实验检验何时能恢复有物理意义的子句，同时明确不宣称量子优势。
items.abstract_zh: Tsetlin Machines（TM）使用有限状态自动机学习可解释的 Boolean 子句。我们提出 Quantum-Logic Tsetlin Machine（QL-TM），它以由投影算符表示的量子命题替代 Boolean 字面量，同时保留经典的包含/排除自动机。子句被限制在可交换测量语境中，并通过其联合投影算符的 Born 概率激活。我们证明，在对角计算基语境中它可精确归约为普通 Boolean TM 子句，并将 Pauli 投影算符子句与稳定子和综合征语义联系起来。在 Bell 态、相位翻转综合征、随机化的 16 类稳定子任务、混合字面量池、语境预算消融和有限采样噪声上的受控实验表明，正确的非对角语境能够恢复具有物理意义的子句，而对角或错误语境会丢失相关的相位/综合征信息。当移除真实稳定子生成元时，语境预算结果紧密遵循预测的可分离性阶梯 2^(b-k)。该工作是在 Tsetlin 子句学习与量子逻辑之间建立受控联系，并不宣称量子优势。

items.title: @NVIDIAAI：We benchmarked 300+ NVIDIA verified skills to see how much they actually help agents on real tasks. Same task, same mode
items.abstract_or_text: We benchmarked 300+ NVIDIA verified skills to see how much they actually help agents on real tasks. Same task, same model, same setup. The only difference was whether the agent had the skill. Across the benchmarks, skills improved correctness by 41 points, effectiveness by 39, and efficiency by 35. SkillEvaluator is open source if you want to test your own skills before you ship them.
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 表示，其在相同任务、模型和设置下比较了 300 余项已验证技能，并报告技能带来三项明显增益。帖文未给出任务构成、指标定义和统计不确定性；编辑认为，其开源评测器及对技能效用的量化主张值得工程团队进一步核查。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体技能的实际收益常被宣传掩盖；这项公开的评测主张为复现实验和比较技能设计提供了具体问题与工具线索。
items.abstract_zh: 我们对 300 多项经 NVIDIA 验证的技能进行了基准测试，以了解它们究竟能在真实任务中为智能体带来多少帮助。同一任务、同一模型、同一设置，唯一的区别是智能体是否拥有该技能。各项基准中，技能将正确性提高了 41 分、效能提高了 39 分、效率提高了 35 分。如果你想在发布前测试自己的技能，SkillEvaluator 已开源。
items.author_line: NVIDIA AI

items.title: @NVIDIAAI：Our general-purpose coding agent just scored 100% on the ARC-AGI-3 interactive reasoning benchmark. NVIDIA AVO completed
items.abstract_or_text: Our general-purpose coding agent just scored 100% on the ARC-AGI-3 interactive reasoning benchmark. NVIDIA AVO completed all 183 levels across all 25 public environments, figuring out what to do with no instructions, explicit rules, or stated goals.
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 宣称其通用编程智能体 AVO 在 25 个公开环境中完成 183 个关卡，并据此称在 ARC-AGI-3 交互式推理基准取得 100%。候选集中同时存在对“公开演示集”与完整基准不能混同的专业质疑；编辑认为该结果重要，但应以独立评测和完整基准定义为准。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 长时程智能体的能力主张需要区分公开环境表现与正式基准成绩，这一案例有助于读者审视评测表述。
items.abstract_zh: 我们的通用编程智能体刚刚在 ARC-AGI-3 交互式推理基准上取得了 100%。NVIDIA AVO 在全部 25 个公开环境中完成了全部 183 个关卡，在没有说明、显式规则或既定目标的情况下判断该做什么。
items.author_line: NVIDIA AI

items.title: @fchollet：This is very nice work from NVIDIA. Like all high-performing approaches on ARC-AGI-3, it uses deep learning-guided on-th
items.abstract_or_text: This is very nice work from NVIDIA. Like all high-performing approaches on ARC-AGI-3, it uses deep learning-guided on-the-fly synthesis of symbolic world models, i.e. navigating the world by generating programs to represent what you know. To be clear, like with several other recent claims, scoring 100% on the public demonstration set is not the same as "scoring 100% on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark". It would be like saying you beat a videogame because you cleared the tutorial level.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 认为 NVIDIA 的工作“非常好”，并将其归入以深度学习引导、即时合成符号世界模型的高表现 ARC-AGI-3 方法。其核心观点是：公开演示集的满分不能表述为完整 ARC-AGI-3 基准的满分；编辑认为这是对近期基准传播中评测范围的必要澄清。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究者对评测口径的公开说明能避免把演示结果扩大为普遍能力结论，也推动了更严谨的基准讨论。
items.abstract_zh: 这是 NVIDIA 非常好的工作。与 ARC-AGI-3 上所有高表现方法一样，它使用深度学习引导的、即时进行的符号世界模型合成，也就是通过生成程序来表示你所知道的内容，从而在世界中导航。需要说明的是，和近来若干其他说法一样，在公开演示集上拿到 100% 并不等于“在 ARC-AGI-3 基准上拿到 100%”。这就像你通关了教程关，便说自己打通了一款电子游戏。
items.author_line: François Chollet

items.title: @percyliang：🚢 Marin 535B-A23B started training this week! As usual, the whole process is open. Voyage plan: pretraining (80%) + midt
items.abstract_or_text: 🚢 Marin 535B-A23B started training this week! As usual, the whole process is open. Voyage plan: pretraining (80%) + midtraining (20%) on 18.75T tokens on 11 x GB200 NVL72 for ~3 months (2.7e24 FLOPs). Post-training will follow. Before kicking off the run, we trained a 4-rung scaling ladder from 1.6B-A61M (48B tokens) to 27.7B-A1.2B (926B tokens) to debug issues, and to make a forecast of our hero run. This is by far our biggest run, so definitely expecting the unexpected.
items.summary_zh: Percy Liang 公布 Marin 535B-A23B 已启动训练，并披露了训练令牌量、硬件规模、预计周期和先行缩放实验。这里的规模、预测和预期均为项目方陈述；编辑认为，公开训练过程与缩放阶梯信息对研究复核和基础设施讨论具有实质价值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大模型训练通常缺少过程信息；这则帖文公开了训练计划和预试验范围，为讨论规模预测、调试和开放研究提供了可检查的细节。
items.abstract_zh: Marin 535B-A23B 本周开始训练！一如既往，整个过程都是开放的。航行计划：在 11 套 GB200 NVL72 上、约 3 个月内，使用 18.75T 个 token 进行预训练（80%）和中期训练（20%）（2.7e24 FLOPs）。随后将进行后训练。在启动这次运行前，我们训练了一个四级缩放阶梯，从 1.6B-A61M（48B 个 token）到 27.7B-A1.2B（926B 个 token），用于调试问题并预测我们的主运行。这是我们迄今最大的运行，因此肯定会有意料之外的事情。
items.author_line: Percy Liang

items.title: @YongchaoC：I kept wondering: every AI benchmark tests whether models can follow a roadmap humans drew. What if we take the roadmap
items.abstract_or_text: I kept wondering: every AI benchmark tests whether models can follow a roadmap humans drew. What if we take the roadmap away?For many research-heavy tasks, how well does current LLM work? We built ASI-Bench to find out. 60 research tasks, 11 fields. Best agent scores 51.60 without human guidance. Open for contributions.
items.summary_zh: Yongchao Chen 介绍 ASI-Bench：涵盖 11 个领域、60 项研究型任务，旨在测试撤去人类预设路线图后智能体的表现；其称最佳智能体在无人类指导时得分为 51.60。编辑认为，这一设计把“自主研究”从常规任务跟随中单独提出，值得关注其任务构造和评测细节。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 许多基准默认人类已把步骤规划好；研究型任务中的自主选题、路径选择和验证能力需要不同的评估方式。
items.abstract_zh: 我一直在想：每个 AI 基准都在测试模型能否遵循人类画出的路线图。如果拿掉路线图会怎样？对于许多研究密集型任务，当前 LLM 的表现到底如何？我们构建了 ASI-Bench 来找答案。60 个研究任务，11 个领域。最佳智能体在无人类指导下得分为 51.60。欢迎贡献。
items.author_line: Yongchao Chen

items.title: Broadening access to Skala creates a faster path to predictive DFT
items.abstract_or_text: Skala 1.1, the updated deep-learning exchange-correlation functional from Microsoft Research, provides greater accuracy, expanded accessibility across the computational chemistry ecosystem, and a living benchmark to track computational performance. The post Broadening access to Skala creates a faster path to predictive DFT appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.summary_zh: 微软研究院宣布更新深度学习交换-相关泛函 Skala 1.1，并称其在计算化学软件生态中提升准确性和可用性，同时提供持续更新的性能基准。上述效果来自官方研究博客摘要；编辑认为，面向可预测 DFT 的模型若能被多种工具链采用，其复现与独立比较将尤其关键。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 交换-相关泛函直接影响 DFT 计算的可靠性；可访问的实现和持续基准有助于将方法评价从单一结果扩展到实际工作流。
items.abstract_zh: Skala 1.1 是微软研究院更新的深度学习交换-相关泛函，在计算化学生态系统中提供更高的准确性、更广的可及性，以及用于追踪计算性能的持续更新基准。文章《扩大 Skala 的可及性，为预测性 DFT 开辟更快路径》最初发表于 Microsoft Research。

items.title: @GoogleDeepMind：Games have been an important testbed for our AI research for over 15 years. 🎮 From mastering Atari to reaching Grandmast
items.abstract_or_text: Games have been an important testbed for our AI research for over 15 years. 🎮 From mastering Atari to reaching Grandmaster in StarCraft II, they have driven some of our biggest AI breakthroughs. Our work with SIMA taught agents how to understand 3D worlds, but learning to navigate real human dynamics takes a living, persistent universe. Through our research partnership with @FenrisCreations, we’re exploring how to tackle open challenges in AI: 🔵 Continual learning to acquire new skills without forgetting past knowledge. 🔵 Deep memory systems that store and retrieve information far beyond today’s context windows. 🔵 Long-horizon planning over weeks, months, or years. 🔵 Multi-agent dynamics spanning cooperation, negotiation, economics, and emergent behaviors. Our long-term goal is to use AI to discover entirely new gameplay experiences in partnership with game developers – making games more accessible and personalized – while applying what we've learned to problems in the real world and scientific discovery. Find out more →
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布与 Fenris Creations 开展研究合作，借助持续存在的游戏世界探索持续学习、深层记忆、长时程规划和多智能体动态。所列方向和长期目标均为发布方陈述；编辑认为，持久多人环境可为超越短回合任务的智能体研究提供有价值的试验条件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 真实感更强、状态持续的交互环境可暴露遗忘、记忆管理、协调和长期规划问题，补充传统静态基准。
items.abstract_zh: 15 年来，游戏一直是我们 AI 研究的重要试验场。🎮 从掌握 Atari 到在《星际争霸 II》中达到宗师段位，它们推动了我们一些最大的 AI 突破。我们在 SIMA 上的工作教会了智能体如何理解 3D 世界，但学习在真实人类互动中导航需要一个有生命力、持续存在的宇宙。通过与 @FenrisCreations 的研究合作，我们正在探索如何应对 AI 的开放挑战：🔵 持续学习，以获得新技能而不遗忘既有技能。🔵 深层记忆系统，存储和检索远超当今上下文窗口的信息。🔵 跨越数周、数月或数年的长时程规划。🔵 涵盖合作、谈判、经济和涌现行为的多智能体动态。我们的长期目标是与游戏开发者合作，利用 AI 发现全新的游戏体验——让游戏更具可及性和个性化——同时把所学应用于现实世界问题和科学发现。了解更多 →
items.author_line: Google DeepMind

items.abstract_or_text: We will continue to offer Zero Data Retention for frontier models. As AI takes on longer, more autonomous work and delivers greater value to businesses, safety systems also need to identify risks across related interactions. To help address those risks, we're previewing Private Safety Processing, which is designed to improve safety without giving OpenAI personnel access to the underlying content.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示将继续为前沿模型提供符合条件的零数据保留，并预览 Private Safety Processing，目标是在员工不访问底层内容的前提下改善安全识别。功能的适用范围、技术实现和独立隐私验证未见于帖文；编辑认为，这是企业采用长时程智能体时值得持续核查的隐私与安全设计方向。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 自主工作流会产生更多相互关联的上下文；如何同时处理风险识别和数据保密，是企业部署中的实际问题。
items.abstract_zh: 我们将继续为前沿模型提供零数据保留。随着 AI 承担更长周期、更自主的工作并为企业提供更大价值，安全系统也需要识别相关交互中的风险。为帮助解决这些风险，我们正在预览 Private Safety Processing，其设计目标是在不让 OpenAI 人员访问底层内容的条件下提升安全性。

items.abstract_or_text: As AI agents take on more complex work, where should security live? The harness guides what an agent tries to do. Infrastructure controls what it can actually do. Our AI safety and security teams share how they’re thinking about security across the agent stack. 👇

items.why_it_matters_zh: 只在单一层面处理智能体安全往往不足；编排逻辑和基础设施权限会共同影响系统实际行为。

items.summary_zh: Langfuse 是开源 AI 工程平台，提供 LLM 评测、可观测性、指标、提示词管理、交互实验台与数据集能力；2026-08-22 位列 GitHub Trending TypeScript 榜第 17 名。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将提示词、调用轨迹、评测数据和运行指标集中到同一工程体系，适合需要持续评估与改进 RAG、智能体或模型应用的研发团队。
items.abstract_zh: 开源 AI 工程平台：提供 LLM 评测、可观测性、指标、提示词管理、交互实验台和数据集；可与 OpenTelemetry、LangChain、OpenAI SDK、LiteLLM 等集成。
items.author_line: langfuse

items.title: ai-dynamo/dynamo
items.abstract_or_text: A Datacenter Scale Distributed Inference Serving Framework

items.abstract_zh: 面向数据中心规模的分布式推理服务框架。
items.author_line: ai-dynamo

items.title: open-metadata/OpenMetadata
items.abstract_or_text: The Open Context Layer for Data and AI , OpenMetadata is the open platform for building trusted data context and business semantics for humans, AI assistants, and agents.
items.summary_zh: OpenMetadata 是面向数据与 AI 的开放上下文平台，为人类、AI 助手和智能体构建可信数据上下文与业务语义；2026-08-22 位列 GitHub Trending TypeScript 榜第 13 名。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 可靠的数据语义和元数据是智能体检索、分析及自动化决策的基础，适合建设企业数据目录、知识上下文或受治理 AI 应用的团队。
items.abstract_zh: 面向数据与 AI 的开放上下文层：OpenMetadata 是一个开放平台，用于为人类、AI 助手和智能体构建可信的数据上下文与业务语义。
items.author_line: open-metadata

items.title: Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard
items.abstract_or_text: A full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems via Agent Scan, Skills Scan, MCP scan, AI Infra scan and LLM jailbreak evaluation.
items.summary_zh: AI-Infra-Guard 是覆盖智能体、Skills、MCP、AI 基础设施扫描及 LLM 越狱评测的全栈 AI 红队平台；2026-08-22 位列 GitHub Trending Python 榜第 4 名。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 智能体工具链扩大了模型应用的攻击面。该项目为安全、平台和智能体研发人员提供统一的风险检查方向，可用于上线前评估与持续安全测试。
items.abstract_zh: 全栈 AI 红队平台，通过智能体扫描、Skills 扫描、MCP 扫描、AI 基础设施扫描和 LLM 越狱评测来保护 AI 生态系统。
items.author_line: Tencent

items.title: hao-ai-lab/FastVideo
items.abstract_or_text: A unified inference and post-training framework for accelerated video generation.
items.summary_zh: FastVideo 是用于加速视频生成的统一推理与后训练框架；2026-08-22 位列 GitHub Trending Python 榜第 14 名。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 视频生成模型往往受制于训练和采样成本。该框架面向推理与后训练两类关键工作，可供研究视频生成、开展模型适配或优化生成服务的读者参考。
items.abstract_zh: 用于加速视频生成的统一推理与后训练框架。
items.author_line: hao-ai-lab

items.title: google/adk-go
items.abstract_or_text: An open-source, code-first Go toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control.
items.summary_zh: ADK-Go 是 Google 推出的开源、代码优先 Go 工具包，用于灵活且可控地构建、评估和部署复杂 AI 智能体；2026-08-22 位列 GitHub Trending Go 榜第 20 名。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将智能体构建、评测与部署纳入 Go 工程体系，适合偏好静态语言、需要服务端可控性或准备将智能体接入既有 Go 服务的研发者。
items.abstract_zh: 开源、代码优先的 Go 工具包，用于以灵活性和可控性构建、评估和部署复杂 AI 智能体。
items.author_line: google

items.title: volcengine/OpenViking
items.abstract_or_text: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
items.summary_zh: OpenViking 是面向 AI 智能体的自演化上下文数据库，统一管理智能体记忆、知识 RAG 与 Skills；2026-08-22 位列 GitHub Trending Python 榜第 16 名。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 长期记忆、检索知识和可复用技能常被分散实现。该项目提出将三者统一管理的工程方向，适合开发复杂工作流、研究型助手和长期运行智能体的团队。
items.abstract_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的自演化上下文数据库，统一智能体记忆、知识 RAG 和 Skills。
items.author_line: volcengine

items.title: zzet/gortex
items.abstract_or_text: High-performance code-intelligence engine for AI agents and IDE, supports 257 languages, multi repositories, based on graph, with access via CLI, MCP Server, and API. AI coding agents teammate - expose only needed information, cutting token usage up to 50x. 100% local. Discord: https://discord.gg/39MFHu3J5d
items.summary_zh: Gortex 是面向 AI 智能体和 IDE 的高性能代码智能引擎，支持 257 种语言、多仓库图谱以及 CLI、MCP Server、API 调用；2026-08-22 位列 GitHub Trending Go 榜第 12 名。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大型代码库中的上下文检索是编码智能体质量和成本的重要因素。它为需要本地代码理解、精简工具输出及多仓库分析的开发者提供了基础能力。
items.abstract_zh: 面向 AI 智能体和 IDE 的高性能代码智能引擎，支持 257 种语言，支持基于图的多仓库分析，并通过 CLI、MCP Server 和 API 提供访问；只暴露所需信息，声称可将 token 用量最多减少 50 倍，且完全本地运行。
items.author_line: zzet
